messages.snippet: Alice, Marcus, As promised, the updated post-completion capitalisation table is attached. Ardent now
messages.subject: Solstice - updated cap table (post-completion)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Marcus,

As promised, the updated post-completion capitalisation table is attached. Ardent now holds 2,000,000 Series A Preferred (25.0% fully diluted); the founders hold 30.0% (Alice) and 22.5% (Sanjay). The EMI pool will move to 12% post-money once the board resolution is passed. Let me know if anything looks off.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
